meta.title: Sound
meta.description: Sound for HTML animation: 38 synthesized presets, 26 layered design recipes, 8 compose genres, narration (MiniMax / OpenAI-compatible / free Edge) and zero-asset singing, plus viseme tracks, beat detection, a page player, mixing, loudness and delivery checks - 17 tools in all. Pick a provider under Settings → Sound; synthesis, composing, singing, alignment and the checks need no key, and the same request always renders the same bytes.
